messages:
chris_cloud: Heads-up — running into ALB/NLB + target-group limits in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for Redwood Private customer onboarding. Need quota increases and private endpoint limits raised.
adele_dev: Which specific quotas? ALB count? TG per ALB? VPC endpoint ENIs? :eyes:
chris_cloud: Quick list from our hit: 1) Application Load Balancers (regional) - currently at ~48/50 in us-west-2 2) Target groups (TG) per region - about 980/1000 3) Network Load Balancers - approaching 45/50 4) Lattice / PrivateLink endpoints (interface endpoints) - default 50, we need 150 in eu-west-1 for per-customer private endpoints 5) ENI limit in the management VPC (ec2) - bump from 4000 to 8000 for cross-account endpoints
samir_ops: Timeline? New customers expecting private endpoints this week, so +1 week SLA would be tight. Also remember ALB target group per-rule limits: we might hit 10 rules/TG combo if we create per-route routing.
chris_cloud: Yep, urgent. I'll draft the support case. Posting the proposed AWS support case body below — please edit: 
```
Subject: Request quota increases for ALB/NLB/TargetGroups and VPC interface endpoints (PrivateLink)
Account ID: 123456789012
Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1
Requested increases:
 - Application Load Balancers (per region): 50 -> 150 (us-west-2)
 - Network Load Balancers (per region): 50 -> 100 (us-west-2, eu-west-1)
 - Target groups (per region): 1000 -> 5000 (us-west-2, eu-west-1)
 - Interface VPC endpoints (com.amazonaws.*): 50 -> 200 (eu-west-1)
 - Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) quota for management VPC: 4000 -> 8000 (us-west-2)
Justification:
 - Redwood Private on-prem + VPC customers require per-customer private endpoints and isolated ALBs per tenant for compliance and routing. We have 12 onboards scheduled in next 14 days with estimated 8 new endpoints each. Additional capacity needed to avoid provisioning failures.
 - Traffic pattern: many small ALBs + many target groups for canary/cross-model routing, which scales target-group usage fast.
Urgency: High (customer onboards and scheduled migrations)
```
adele_dev: That reads fine. Add a sentence about expected long-term growth (12 mo forecast) and whether we can get a soft limit now and revisit. Also include contact person: chris_cloud@redwood.com and escalation phone.
chris_cloud: Good call. I'll add 12-month forecast numbers and contact.
lex_platform: FYI we also need to check CloudFront/ALB cert limits but those are separate. For the support case, add request for per-account per-region increases not per-VPC.
aws-support-bot: Case 987654321 opened with AWS Support (Trusted Advisor alerted). Estimated response SLA: 24-48 hours.
samir_ops: Can we temporarily mitigate by reusing target groups and consolidating listeners? Might buy us time if AWS is slow.
adele_dev: We can, but that increases risk for feature gating per-tenant routing. Ops approval needed.
chris_cloud: I'll proceed with the case updates and ping infra-oncall if we see provisioning errors. If AWS denies, next plan: 1) Gate onboarding 2) Consolidate TGs 3) Explore NLB per-customer with shared ALB fallback.
samir_ops: Sounds good. Please paste the final case id here when you have it. :thumbsup:
chris_cloud: Will do — case 987654321 confirmed. Thanks all.
